items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Then there was Tiny, Tiny Parham, I think that's the name, I'm not sure, Tiny.

ctx.x: No, but while I was -- I'm going back to Chicano. While I was in Blue Island, I used to hear broadcasts of Fletcher Henderson. And a -- that's another fellow that a, that really, really started me into thinking of jazz also. While I was Chicago, in Chicago -- I'm going back again -- I used to hear Carroll Dickerson, and he was at the Vendome. Then there was Tiny, Tiny Parham, I think that's the name, I'm not sure, Tiny. It also -- as I say, Jean Goldkette and Cotton Pickers. . . And one time, . . .
